name_en: Hatahata no karaage — whole sandfish deep-fried until the bones turn crisp
summary_ja: 頭と内臓を取ったハタハタを丸ごと油で揚げる但馬地域の料理。うろこがなく調理しやすい魚とされ、朝鮮半島から回遊してくるため抱卵しておらず身に脂がのるという但馬産の特徴を生かした一品。
summary_en: Whole sandfish, head and innards removed, deep-fried in the Tajima region. Sandfish are said to be scaleless and easy to prepare, and because the ones landed here migrate up from the Korean peninsula without eggs yet developing, their flesh is said to carry more fat.
source_publisher: 農林水産省「うちの郷土料理」
